title: Branches with loops
instruction: For each remaining item in "Coral", in displayed order, execute [If the category of the current item in "Coral" does not equal "blue", execute [Click Approve for the current item in "Coral"]; otherwise execute [Click Reject for the current item in "Coral"]], then click Next on "Coral". Stop when no items remain. When the whole script is complete, click Done. Do not perform any extra actions.
